steps.title: Auth & Config — GET new_request_config
steps.plain: Sign in with the account's token and read its event settings: how long an RFP runs, how it is evaluated and closed, and which terms and conditions exist.
steps.expected: The token is accepted (200), the run's settings are valid, and the account has duration presets for RFP events.
steps.actual: Signed in. RFQ events here run 30 min by default with a 30 min evaluation window, closing "line_item_based".

The default evaluation window is one of the allowed windows
The default closing mode is a known value
The default RFP evaluation mode is a known value
Terms and conditions have unique ids

steps.expected: The search returns products, and enough of them are active and approved to make the line items asked for.

Enough eligible products for 2 line items
Unit and variant overrides fit the chosen products
Every quantity is a positive number

steps.title: Get Template Details — GET templates/:uuid
steps.plain: Open the chosen template — the questions of an RFP, or the price widgets of an RFQ.
steps.expected: The template opens (200); it is the one chosen, its question keys are unique and its question types are supported.
steps.actual: "Bug template" is a buy template with 13 price widget(s): product, creator_quantity, buyer_hub, price, participant_quantity, total_amount, gst_custom, gst_per_unit_custom, total_gst_custom, basic_price_incl_taxes_custom, landed_price, landed_price_custom, price_duplicate.

The vendor's price and quantity are required
Formula widgets are read-only and only refer to widgets that exist
The order type is buy or sell
The extra widgets asked for exist in the template
The extra total widgets asked for exist in the template

steps.plain: Read the account's RFQ settings for the chosen template: how long it may run and how it closes.
steps.expected: The settings come back (200) with an RFQ duration preset, and the run's duration is one the template allows.
steps.actual: RFQs from this template run 30 min by default; allowed: 30 min, 60 min, 240 min, 1440 min.
